fact: Decree 2023-515 of 9 May 2023 provides that the unique identification number (NUI) is assigned at birth, or after transcription of a court judgment for a birth certificate, through the civil registry information system, with a progressive rollout.
title: Décret n° 2023-515 relatif au Numéro Unique d'Identification (NUI)
publisher: Primature, Ministère de l'Intérieur et de la Décentralisation, Madagascar
